disposition.reason: This docket is a state enforcement action: the Agency of Natural Resources filed its Administrative Order against an unpermitted salvage yard, not an appeal of a municipal decision. The subject is junk vehicle storage at a towing business, not new housing.

evidence.quote: That AO was filed with the Court on September 27, 2016, thereby commencing this enforcement action.
received a complaint alleging use of the Tunbridge property as a salvage yard.
Respondent Kyle Blakeman operates an automobile towing and recovery business known as Blakeman’s Towing and Recovery on the Tunbridge property.

judgments.note: ANR enforcement of the state salvage yard law commenced by filing its Administrative Order; the only municipal action mentioned (the Town's December 2017 COAL denial) is background and not appealed in this docket. Nonresidential subject.
State-brought enforcement without an appeal of a municipal decision.
Salvage yard and towing business; no housing proposed.

history.note: Excluded: ANR salvage-yard enforcement and contempt proceedings, not a municipal housing appeal.
